Case: FB-2025-00002

30 September 2026

Dear Sir/Madam,

Thank you for your feedback received on 2 October 2025 regarding a leaking ceiling at Blk 675 #02-07.

We have looked into the matter. Our contractor sealed the ceiling joint on 5 October 2025.

Reference: IEMS-2510-0002

If it recurs, please call us on 6100 2058.

We appreciate you taking the time to help us keep our estates safe and pleasant.

Yours sincerely,

Siti Aishah Yusof

Customer Relations
